renderer.description: Template engine to render with. Defaults to the standard text/template renderer.

inputs.description: Values asked from the user, available to templates as .Inputs.<name>.Value.

env.description: Values made available to templates as .Env.Name. String values are rendered as templates that can use the inputs, so a derived value is defined once. They cannot refer to other env values.

raw.description: Globs of files copied without rendering their names or contents, e.g. files that use {{ }} themselves. A pattern can match a file's path, its name, or any parent directory; ** matches across directories.

exclude.description: Paths left out of the generated project, before rendering, whenever the condition renders as true.

rename.description: Paths moved once the project is rendered, in the order listed, e.g. from github to .github so files for generated projects stay inert in the template's own repository. Raw and exclude patterns refer to the template's own names, before renaming.

glob.description: A doublestar glob, e.g. internal/server, *.tpl, **/*_test.go or Dockerfile{,.dev}.

description.description: Shown to the user when asking for the value.

default.description: Used when the user gives no answer. An input without a default is required. A string may be a template that uses the values of other inputs, e.g. github.com/{{.Inputs.Owner.Value}}/{{.Inputs.Name.Value}}; the input is then asked after those.

choices.description: The only values accepted for this input. A default must be one of them.

from.description: Path as it is named once the template is rendered, itself rendered as a template. It must exist.

to.description: Path in the generated project, rendered as a template. It must not exist yet; missing parent directories are created.

when.description: A template that must render as true or false. The rename is skipped when it is false; without it the rename always applies.

paths.description: Several globs that share the same condition.

when.description: A template that must render as true or false, e.g. {{eq .Inputs.kind.Value "cli"}}. Without it the paths are always excluded.
